description.value: Your Independent Grocer is a Canadian full-service supermarket chain operated by Loblaw Companies Limited, offering a broad range of grocery, fresh produce, household, and personal care products. This Vancouver location would serve touring cyclists as a resupply point for food and provisions. The chain's PC Express service also supports online ordering for pickup.
